description: Kubernetes 1.34 is past Azure Kubernetes Service standard support (ended 2026-11-30). Azure Kubernetes Service ended standard support for Kubernetes 1.34 on 2026-11-30; extended support, which applies only if Long Term Support is enabled, runs until 2027-11-30; upgradescope cannot see whether this cluster is enrolled. AKS has no automatic extended support. Without Long Term Support (which needs the Premium tier), a cluster past community support gets only platform support (Azure and AKS platform issues, no Kubernetes fixes) while its minor is N-3, one behind the oldest minor in community support. Older minors are out of support. Fix: Upgrade the control plane to a Kubernetes minor that is still in standard support.
